title: Send structured message data
summary: WebSockets: Send structured message data. Send score 7.
introduction: JSON can give a message named fields. The server reads score and doubles it.
learningObjectives: Send structured message data with WebSockets

blocks.text: Run npm init -y and npm install ws@8 in a practice folder. Save each example as lesson.mjs and run node lesson.mjs. Each file starts a local server and test client, prints a result, then closes both.

blocks.title: Send structured message data

blocks.text: The client sends score 4 as JSON. The server parses it, doubles the number, and serialises answer 8.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Real message handlers need checks for invalid JSON and invalid fields.
